## Purpose

This page collects links to public data resources used for *Staurois parvus* RNA-seq analysis in the Mangiamele Lab.

## Download Notes

When adding data links, record:

- Repository name
- Accession number
- Date accessed
- File names downloaded
- Genome or annotation version
- Any filtering or processing already performed

This information makes the analysis easier to reproduce later.
